snippet.title: PlayStation - Kyuukuoku no Soukoban (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Kyuukuoku no Soukoban is a Puzzle game, developed by Thinking Rabbit and published by Itochu, which was released in Japan in 1996.
